summary: Frontend-only regression of Individual/Business account UX + Quick Actions suggestion + no-results empty states + publishable-keys 400 fix. Login as hostbay@moxx.co worked. 7/9 scenarios fully verified pass, 1 partial pass (Test 4 - activation renders correctly but competes with old OnboardingFlow), 1 could not reproduce because /pay-links search input did not respond to Playwright typing (transactions search worked identically).

ui_bugs.issue: For a real merchant on the activation state (hasAccount && hasWallet && !hasPayment && !profileComplete) BOTH the OLD 'Finish setting up' OnboardingFlow checklist AND the NEW dash2026-activation card render at the same time on /dashboard. Because pages/dashboard.tsx unconditionally renders <OnboardingFlow /> and OnboardingFlow's `showChecklist` becomes true whenever !allCoreDone && !hasPayment. The activation-only path should suppress the legacy OnboardingFlow (e.g. bail early from OnboardingFlow when hasAccount && hasWallet, or move that decision to dash2026).

The 'Search links...' input on /pay-links did not filter the list nor render [data-testid=no-results-payment-links] when a nonsense string was entered by any of the automated methods tried (page.fill, press_sequentially, and native React value setter + input event dispatch). The identical technique works on /transactions. The list stayed at all 28-30 links with no client filtering. Suspect the InputBase's onChange -> handleSearch path is not wired at runtime, or the value is being reset by the top bar's `key={filterResetKey}` remount. Needs manual repro by main agent.

rca_of_the_issue: OnboardingFlow overlap: pages/dashboard.tsx line ~96 renders <OnboardingFlow /> unconditionally, and OnboardingFlow's own suppression rule (`coreReady && !hasPayment && !allCoreDone`) becomes true for the exact same population Dashboard2026's showActivation targets, so both draw on the same page. pay-links search: needs code-level trace — likely the top bar remount via filterResetKey drops keystrokes, or the InputBase renders after our locator resolves; either way the client filter path (searchQuery -> filteredLinks) does not update when the input is driven programmatically, while /transactions (Enter-to-search) works fine.
